map.股票盈亏计算 使用指南: Stock Profit and Loss Calculator User Guide
map.输入买入价、卖出价、股数与佣金税费，计算股票交易的毛利润、净盈亏与收益率，用于复: Enter the buy price, sell price, share count, commission and taxes to compute the gross profit, net profit and return of a stock trade, for reviewing transaction costs and real profitability.
map.净盈亏 = 卖出额 − 买入额 − 买入佣金 − 卖出佣金 − 印花税 − 过户: Net profit = sell value − buy value − buy commission − sell commission − stamp duty − transfer fee; commission = max(turnover × commission rate, minimum commission); stamp duty = sell value × tax rate (sell side only)
map.买入额 = 买入价×股数、卖出额 = 卖出价×股数；佣金按成交额比例收取且不低于: Buy value = buy price × shares, sell value = sell price × shares; commission is charged as a percentage of turnover but never below the minimum commission; stamp duty applies to the sell side only, and the transfer fee is charged as a percentage of turnover on both sides.
map.计算买入后至少涨到什么价格卖出才能覆盖全部交易成本（佣金、印花税、过户费）。: Work out the minimum selling price after buying that covers all transaction costs (commission, stamp duty, transfer fee).
map.短线交易前评估最低涨幅阈值。: Estimate the minimum rise needed before a short-term trade to break even.
map.比较不同券商佣金率下的真实保本点。: Compare the true break-even point under different broker commission rates.
map.：买入额=10000 元。佣金率 0.025%（最低 5 元）→ 佣 5 元；印: Buy value = 10,000 CNY. Commission 0.025% (minimum 5 CNY) gives 5 CNY; stamp duty on the sell side only at 0.05% gives 5 CNY (estimating on a 10,000 CNY sale); the transfer fee at 0.001% both ways is about 0.2 CNY. The break-even price ≈ (10000+5+5+0.2)/1000 ≈ 10.02 CNY, that is a rise of about 0.2% breaks even.
map.降低佣金率影响: The effect of a lower commission rate
map.：若佣金率 0.015%（最低 5 元仍 5 元），小单成本主要由最低佣金决定；: If the commission rate is 0.015% (still 5 CNY because of the minimum), the cost of a small order is driven by the minimum commission; on a large order such as 100,000 CNY the 15 CNY commission makes the break-even price noticeably different.

map.印花税现在怎么收？: How is stamp duty charged these days?
map.A股卖出时收成交额的 0.05%（2023 年减半后），买入不收；过户费沪深均约: On A-shares, stamp duty is 0.05% of the turnover on the sell side only (halved in 2023); the transfer fee is about 0.001% on both the Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges.
map.最低佣金 5 元怎么处理？: How is the 5 CNY minimum commission handled?
map.单笔佣金不足 5 元按 5 元收，小额交易实际费率远高于名义费率，保本点主要由最: When per-trade commission falls below 5 CNY it is charged as 5 CNY, so the effective rate on small trades is far above the nominal rate and the break-even point is pushed up mainly by the minimum commission.
